cards.ex: That cat video really went viral; everyone's sharing it.
cards.exUz: O'sha mushuk videosi juda ommalashib ketdi; hamma uni ulashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Internetda juda tez va keng tarqalmoq, mashhur bo'lib ketmoq.

cards.ex: I need to stop doomscrolling before I get even more depressed.
cards.exUz: Men yanada tushkunlikka tushmasimdan oldin yomon yangiliklarni o'qishni to'xtatishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Faqat yomon yangiliklarni ko'rish uchun internetni tinimsiz ko'zdan kechirish.

cards.ex: It's important to break out of your filter bubble and listen to different viewpoints.
cards.exUz: O'z filtr pufagingizdan chiqib, turli nuqtai nazarlarni tinglash muhim.
cards.uzDef: Faqat o'zingizga o'xshash fikrlarni ko'rsatadigan internet muhiti.

cards.ex: Don't feed the trolls; just ignore them.
cards.exUz: Trollarni boqmang; shunchaki ularni e'tiborga olmang.
cards.uzDef: Internetda boshqalarni g'azablantirish uchun provokatsion xabarlar yozadigan odam.

cards.ex: Cancel culture can be pretty harsh; sometimes people deserve a second chance.
cards.exUz: Bekor qilish madaniyati juda qattiq bo'lishi mumkin; ba'zan odamlar ikkinchi imkoniyatga loyiqdir.
cards.uzDef: Xato qilgan odamlarni ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda qoralash va izolyatsiya qilish.

cards.ex: Be careful what you post online; it all adds to your digital footprint.
cards.exUz: Onlaynda nima joylashtirayotganingizga ehtiyot bo'ling; bularning barchasi sizning raqamli izingizni oshiradi.
cards.uzDef: Internetda qoldirgan barcha ma'lumotlar va faoliyat izlari.

cards.ex: The article had a really catchy headline, so I clicked on it.
cards.exUz: Maqolaning sarlavhasi juda diqqatni tortuvchi edi, shuning uchun men uni bosdim.
cards.uzDef: O'quvchini jalb qilish uchun yaratilgan qisqa va ta'sirli sarlavha.

cards.ex: That website is full of clickbait; don't trust anything you see there.
cards.exUz: Ushbu veb-sayt klikbeytga to'la; u erda ko'rgan hech narsangizga ishonmang.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarni havola ustiga bosishga undash uchun mo'ljallangan aldovchi sarlavha.

cards.ex: It's important to maintain a positive online presence for your career.
cards.exUz: Karyerangiz uchun ijobiy onlayn mavjudligingizni saqlab turish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsning yoki kompaniyaning internetdagi faoliyati va obro'si.

cards.ex: She's a real social butterfly; she's always posting on Instagram.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy ijtimoiy kapalak; u doimo Instagramda xabar joylashtiradi.
cards.uzDef: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda juda faol va mashhur bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: Cyberbullying is a serious problem, and we need to do more to prevent it.
cards.exUz: Kiberbulling jiddiy muammo va biz uni oldini olish uchun ko'proq harakat qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Internet orqali odamlarni haqorat qilish yoki qo'rqitish.

cards.ex: I almost fell for a phishing scam, but I noticed the email address was fake.
cards.exUz: Men deyarli fishing firibgarligiga tushib qoldim, lekin elektron pochta manzilining soxta ekanligini payqadim.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy ma'lumotlarni o'g'irlash uchun soxta elektron pochta orqali tuzoq qo'yish.

cards.ex: Social media helps me stay connected with my friends who live far away.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar menga uzoqda yashaydigan do'stlarim bilan aloqada bo'lishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalar bilan internet orqali aloqani davom ettirmoq.

cards.ex: I often scroll through my social media feed when I'm bored.
cards.exUz: Men zerikkanimda ko'pincha ijtimoiy tarmoqlarimdagi yangiliklarni varaqlab chiqaman.
cards.uzDef: Ekranda ma'lumotni tezda ko'rib chiqmoq.

cards.ex: Don't forget to double-tap if you like the picture!
cards.exUz: Agar rasm sizga yoqsa, ikki marta bosishni unutmang!
cards.uzDef: Instagramda rasmni yoqtirish uchun ikki marta bosish.

cards.ex: I tagged you in that photo from the party last night.
cards.exUz: Men sizni kechagi ziyofatdagi suratda belgiladim.
cards.uzDef: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda boshqa odamning nomini belgilash.

cards.ex: I had to unfollow him because he was always posting annoying things.
cards.exUz: Men uni obuna qilishni to'xtatishim kerak edi, chunki u doimo bezovta qiladigan narsalarni joylashtirardi.
cards.uzDef: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda biror kishining yangiliklarini ko'rmaslik uchun obunani bekor qilmoq.

cards.ex: Use the hashtag #travelphotography if you want people to see your photos.
cards.exUz: Agar siz fotosuratlaringizni ko'rishni istasangiz, #travelphotography heshtegidan foydalaning.
cards.uzDef: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda xabarlarni guruhlash uchun ishlatiladigan belgi (#).

cards.ex: She's going live on Instagram later to answer questions about her book.
cards.exUz: U keyinroq Instagramda kitobi haqidagi savollarga javob berish uchun jonli efirga chiqadi.
cards.uzDef: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda jonli video efirni boshlamoq.

cards.ex: Brands often work with influencers to promote their products.
cards.exUz: Brendlar ko'pincha o'z mahsulotlarini targ'ib qilish uchun influenserlar bilan ishlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda ko'plab izdoshlarga ega bo'lgan va boshqalarga ta'sir o'tkaza oladigan odam.

cards.ex: It's nice to finally meet you IRL after talking online for so long.
cards.exUz: Uzoq vaqt onlaynda gaplashgandan keyin nihoyat siz bilan hayotda uchrashish yoqimli.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqiy hayotda, internetda emas.

cards.ex: I muted him because he was posting too many political opinions.
cards.exUz: Men uni ovozini o'chirdim, chunki u juda ko'p siyosiy fikrlar bildirayotgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda biror kishining xabarlarini ko'rmaslik uchun o'chirib qo'ymoq, lekin obunani bekor qilmasdan.

cards.ex: I need to update my profile picture; it's really old.
cards.exUz: Men profil rasmini yangilashim kerak; u juda eski.
cards.uzDef: Ijtimoiy tarmoq akkauntidagi asosiy rasm.

cards.ex: Social networking can be a great way to meet new people.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar yangi odamlar bilan tanishishning ajoyib usuli bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar orqali boshqalar bilan aloqa o'rnatish.

cards.ex: I found a great online community for writers; it's very supportive.
cards.exUz: Men yozuvchilar uchun ajoyib onlayn jamoa topdim; u juda qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Internetda umumiy qiziqishlar bo'yicha birlashgan odamlar guruhi.

cards.ex: Internet addiction is a real problem that can affect people's lives.
cards.exUz: Internetga qaramlik - bu odamlarning hayotiga ta'sir qilishi mumkin bo'lgan haqiqiy muammo.
cards.uzDef: Internetdan haddan tashqari foydalanish va undan voz kecha olmaslik.

cards.ex: I always check my feed first thing in the morning.
cards.exUz: Men har doim ertalab birinchi navbatda lentamni tekshiraman.
cards.uzDef: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda yangiliklarni ko'rib chiqmoq.

cards.ex: The company announced a data breach that affected millions of users.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya millionlab foydalanuvchilarga ta'sir qilgan ma'lumotlar buzilishini e'lon qildi.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy ma'lumotlarning ruxsatsiz kirishi yoki o'g'irlanishi.

cards.ex: Be careful not to click on links in phishing emails; they could steal your password.
cards.exUz: Fishing xatlaridagi havolalarni bosmaslikka ehtiyot bo'ling; ular sizning parolingizni o'g'irlashi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy ma'lumotlarni o'g'irlashga urinadigan soxta elektron pochta xati.

cards.ex: Make sure to check your privacy settings to protect your personal information.
cards.exUz: Shaxsiy ma'lumotlaringizni himoya qilish uchun maxfiylik sozlamalarini tekshiring.
cards.uzDef: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda ma'lumotlaringizni kim ko'rishini sozlash imkoniyati.
